purpose: Rank candidates from a rights-cleared corpus that already contains qualifying human annotations; this does not authorize new human labeling.

rankingStages.rule: Apply legal/provenance, language, length, first-person Event, duplication, and source-group filters before model inference.
Run the frozen incumbent and frozen balanced-head candidate only; record Product-18 probabilities and canonical outputs without opening source labels.
Prioritize rows where balanced-head adds a priority label, where a priority-pair score margin is small, or where incumbent and balanced-head disagree on cardinality.
Use deterministic round-robin selection across priority pairs and source groups; do not select by RTN/COSO similarity or desired evaluation outcome.
After row IDs are frozen, reveal the pre-existing human annotations and admit only rows satisfying the explicit-positive/explicit-negative schema.

forbidden: COSO row reuse as training data
model-generated label acceptance as human gold
manual cherry-picking after labels are opened
